FreeType 2.15.0
https://download.savannah.gnu.org/releases/freetype/freetype-2.15.0.tar.xz

Used under the FreeType License (docs/FTL.TXT), which asks for a credit in
the documentation: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md carries it.

Kept: include/, and of src/ the modules for TrueType and OpenType (CFF)
fonts - base, autofit, cff, psaux, psnames, pshinter, sfnt, smooth,
truetype, gzip (WOFF's zlib) and svg (OT-SVG glyphs). Dropped: the other
drivers (Type 1, CID, PFR, Type 42, Windows FNT, PCF, BDF, HVF), the raster
and SDF renderers, the cache, bzip2, the validators, tools, builds/, tests
and the documentation but its licenses.

Patches:
- include/freetype/config/ftmodule.h: registers the kept modules alone.

deps/CMakeLists.txt builds the kept modules with the default ftoption.h:
no external zlib, libpng, bzip2, HarfBuzz or Brotli.
